fee_notes: Standard single-unit "Initial Franchise Fee" is $50,000, paid in a lump sum, fully earned and non-refundable upon signing. During fiscal year ended December 31, 2025, two existing franchisees paid a reduced fee of $10,000 each. Multi-3 Area Development Fee is $130,000 (covering up to three locations; no additional Initial Franchise Fee required for the two add-on units). A four-unit multipack was also sold for $125,000. An optional Ghost Kitchen Fee of $25,000 applies to existing franchisees only and is separate from the franchise fee.
raw_excerpt:
The "Initial Franchise Fee" for a single Cheba Hut Business is $50,000. The Initial Franchise Fee is payment for the pre-opening assistance that we provide to you to allow you to open your Cheba Hut Business and also offsets some of our franchise recruitment expenses. The Initial Franchise Fee is paid in a lump sum, uniform, fully earned by us once paid and is non-refundable under any circumstances. The Initial Franchise Fee is payable when you sign your Franchise Agreement.

During our last fiscal year ended December 31, 2025, we collected a reduced initial franchise fee of $10,000 from two existing franchisees, a reduced multipack franchise fee of $130,000 for the sale of three Franchises and one for $125,000 for a multipack for the sale of four Franchises.
